property_summary: For any feeRate input within the allowed range (<=5000), the reference contract stores feeRate equal to the provided _feeRate; the mutant instead overwrites it to 5000 for some inputs (when _feeRate != 5000), so the stored feeRate will differ.
change_summary: Replace the assignment to feeRate to always set it to the maximum allowed 5000, changing stored feeRate after initialize.
